description: This file exports functions and types related to search setup and configuration for onboarding, importing functions and types from a search setup flow module.

methods.name: applySearchKey
methods.description: Function related to applying a search key as part of the search setup process.

methods.name: applySearchProviderSelection
methods.description: Function used to select and apply a search provider.

methods.name: hasExistingKey
methods.description: Checks if an existing search key is present.

methods.name: hasKeyInEnv
methods.description: Checks for a search key in environment variables.

methods.name: resolveExistingKey
methods.description: Resolves an existing search key, potentially from multiple sources.

methods.name: resolveSearchProviderOptions
methods.description: Resolves options for the search provider configuration.

methods.name: runSearchSetupFlow (aliased as setupSearch)
methods.description: Initiates the search setup flow process.
